CustomObject.description: A record that a person looked at two records the duplicate scan proposed and said they are not the same household or the same person, so that the scan does not propose them again (canonical model Section 29A, rule R-DP5). Rows of Kind Match Reason instead hold why the scan proposed a suggestion a match source found (R-DP6), keyed by the duplicate record set. These are the only things duplicate detection stores: the suggestions themselves are the platform's own duplicate record sets. Public read and write, because a dismissal is the organization's decision rather than one person's.
CustomObject.label: Duplicate Dismissal
